主要内容: Broadway Financial Corporation received a notification from Nasdaq on January 3, 2013, that it failed to comply with Nasdaq's Marketplace Rule 5550(a)(2) due to its common stock's bid price closing below $1.00 per share for 30 consecutive business days. The notification has no immediate effect on the listing of the Company's common stock. The Company has 180 calendar days, or until July 2, 2013, to regain compliance with the Rule. If the bid price of the Company's common stock closes at or above $1.00 per share for 10 consecutive business days before July 2, 2013, Nasdaq will provide written notification that the Company has achieved compliance. If compliance cannot be demonstrated by July 2, 2013, the Company's common stock will be subject to delisting from The Nasdaq Capital Market. The Company is pursuing a comprehensive Recapitalization to reduce approximately $22 million of senior debt, preferred stock, and related accumulated dividends. The Company will continue to monitor the bid price for its common stock and consider various options available to it if its common stock does not trade at a level that is likely to regain compliance.
